newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HIH Winterthur sees growth in Asia.
newsitem.headline: HIH Winterthur sees growth in Asia.

text.p: Insurance group HIH Winterthur International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday there were good growth opportunities for the company in Asia.
"We certainly see some good growth prospects in Asia," chief executive Ray Williams said, adding that there were particularly strong opportunities in public liability insurance.
"We'll certainly be writing more public liability there," he told reporters.
HIH Winterthur currently has an Asian base in Hong Kong.

HIH Winterthur, which is controlled by Winterthur Swiss Insurance Co, earlier reported a 73 percent jump in net profit to A$26.1 million in the first half of 1996 and predicted a stronger result in the second half.
At 12.23 p.m. (0223 GMT), its shares were down three cents at A$2.56.
